brief:
Norman Finkelstein's final book exposes deceit and politicking at the world's highest international courts that enabled the Gaza genocide, according to The Chris Hedges Report. The work comprehensively documents how careerism among international legal institutions undermined accountability and justice mechanisms designed to prevent mass atrocities.

Finkelstein argues the international community's failure to act through established legal channels represents a fundamental breakdown of the post-World War II order, with consequences extending beyond Gaza itself.
dek: Norman Finkelstein, in his final book, comprehensively exposes the deceit, politicking, and careerism that enabled the Gaza genocide at the world’s highest international courts.
title: Finkelstein documents international court failures enabling Gaza genocide
